content: Filate Isare loigiye edde beša beši souk maraiye.
Šoinno okkole keṛa lota diyore ekkan taz banaiye edde hibar matat buwai diye. Ar hitara hibare ugguwa baiyonna rongor zubba o findai diye.
Tarfore hitara hibar hãse zai zai hodde, "Oh Ihudi okkolor badšar hayat lamba ok!" Ar hitara hibare suwar maijje.
Filat abar mainšor dolor heṛe niyoli aišše edde Ihudi okkolore hodde, "So, ãi hitare tũwarar hãse niyolai anir zene tũwara buzi faro ze, ãi hitar hono hosuri no fair."
Isaye he keṛar taz edde baiyonna rongor hor finda abostat maze baire aišše. Hetunot Filate mainšore hodde, "Oto so ei manušwa!"
Kintu Isare dekiyore ḍõr imam edde faharadar okkole guzoriyore hodde, "Kurušot do, itare kurušot do!" Filate hodde, "Tũwara itare loizaiyore kurušot dogoi! Ãi hitar hono hosuri no fair."
Ihudi okkole hodde, "Ãrattu ek ain ase, he ain mozin hitattu mora foribo, kiyollahoile hite nizore Allar Fut hoiye."
Filate zehon ei hota fuinne hetunot hite aro ḍoraiye;
edde hite abar mehelor butore giye edde Isare hodde, "Tui honttu aiššos?" Kintu Isaye hitare hono zuwab no de.
Filate hodde, "Tui ki ãr loi hota no hoibi? Tui ki no zanos ze, tore eridibar edde kurušot dibar kemota ãttu asede?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Uwottu tũware kemota diya no oito buli ãr uwore tũwar hono kemota no takito; etolla hite ze ãre tũwar hatot tuli diye, hitar guna beši ḍõr."

content: Ei hota funi Filate Isare eridibolla kušiš goijje, kintu Ihudi okkole guzori hoiye, "Õne zodi itare erido, toile õne Kaisaror bondu no; ze honokiye nizore badša dabi gore hite to Kaisaror bifokke hota ho."
Filate ei hota zehon fuinne, hite Isare baire ainne edde ek šil bisaiya zagat bisaror siyarot boišše, (ze zagaganore Ibroni zubanot Gabbata howa oito).
He dinnan aššil uddar id entezamor din; hẽtte ṭaim oilde dũijja. Filate Ihudi okkolore hodde, "Ei so, tũwarar badša"
Henot hitara guzori hodde, "Dur goro! Dur goro! hitare kurušot do." Filate hitarare hodde, "Tũwarar badšare ki ãi kurušot diyum?" Ḍõr imam okkole zuwab diye, "Kaisar bade ãrattu ar hono badša nai."
Toi hite Isare hitarar hatot tuli diye, zene hibare kurušot diya o. Isare kurušot diya edde moron (Moti 27:31–56; Mark 15:21–41; Luk 23:26–49) Toi hitara hibare hentu loi giyegoi;
ar hiba nizor kuruš boi loizaiyore Matakuli name ek zagat giye (ziyanore Ibroni zubanot Golgotá ho.)
Heṛe hitara Isare kurušot diye, edde hibar fũwati aro duizonore diye, ekzonore ek ḍakottu ek ḍakottu, ar maze Isare.
Filate ekkan dušnama lekiyore Isar kurušor uwore lagai diye, ar leka aššil: "NASARATOR ISA, IHUDI OKKOLOR BADŠA."
Ihudi okkolor boute he dušnamagan foijje, kiyollahoile Isare kurušot diya oiyede zagagan aššilde šohoror ḍake, ar hiyan leka aššil Ibroni, Romiyo edde Girik bašat.
Ihudi okkolor ḍõr imam okkole Filatore hodde, "'Ihudi okkolor badša no leikko,' kintu leko ze, ite hoito, 'ãi Ihudi okkolor badša.'"
Filate hodde, "Ãi ziyan lekki, hiyan ãi lekki."
Šoinno okkole Isare kurušot di bade, hitara hibar horgunore sair bag goriyore ekzone ek bag gori loiye, ar zubba o loiye; kintu hiba silaiya nu aššil, uwottu nise foijjonto banaiya.
Toi hitara ekzonore ekzone hodde, "Iyan no faṛiyum, bolke iyanolla loṭari mari, sai iba har o." Zene ei kalam furon oi fare,

content: Ar hendilla in okkol ei šoinno okkole goijje.
Ar Isar kurušor ḍake hibar ma, hibar mar boin, Klofasor bou Moriyam, edde Mogdaleni Moriyam, itara tiyat aššil.
Isaye, mare edde sahabi zare hibaye ador gorito, hitara tiyai taikkede dekiyore, hibaye mare hodde,
Tarfore he sahabire hodde,
He oite, he sahabiye hibare hitar nizor górot loigiyegoi.
Tarfore, Isaye buzi farer ze beggun šeš oiye, kitabor kalam zene furon o, hibaye hodde,
Heṛe horor roš furaiya ugguwa dešši aššil, toi hitara ekkan hanire he horor rošot bizaiye edde esup gasor ḍeila loi hin Isar mukor hãse doijje.
Isaye he horor roš haiyore hodde,
Tarfore hibaye mata niso gori hibar šeš niyaš felaiye.

He dinnan aššilde entezamor din, ar Šabbator din zene lašgun kurušor uwore no take, kiyollahoile he Šabbat aššilde ek moha din, etolla Ihudi okkole Filatore foriyad goijje zene hitarar ṭenggun bangi diyore hitarare kurušottu lamaifela o.
Toi šoinno okkol aiyore foila ekzonore, edde hibar fũwati kurušot diya oiyede dusora ekzonore, ṭenggun bangi diye.
Kintu hitara zẽtte Isar hãse aiyore dekilo ze, hiba mori giyegoi, toi hibar ṭeng no bange.
Kintu soinno okkolor ekzone hibar ḍak sai sel loiyore hana goijje; henot toratori lou edde fani niyoli aišše.
Ze nizor suke deikke, hite goba diye, ar hitar goba soiyi. Ar hite zane ze hite soiyi hor, zene tũwara o biššaš goro.
Haron in okkol goiṭṭe, zene kitabor ei kalam furon o, "Hibar ekkan ãḍḍi o banga no oibo."
Abar kitabor ar ek kalam endilla hor, "Hitara zare hana goijje hibare hitara saibo."

Ar in okkol bade, Arimatiyar Yusuf, ze aššil Isar sahabi, kintu Ihudi okkolor ḍore gufone aššil, hibaye Filatore foriyad goijje, zene hibaye Isar gagan loizai fare; Filate loizaibolla ezajot diye. Toi hibaye aiyore hibar gagan loigiyegoi.
Ar Nikoḍomas, hiba ze foilabar raitta Isar hãse aiššil, hibaye o heṛe aššil, myrrah edde aloi miyaiya onumanik ek šot fond mosolla loiyore.
Hitara Isar ga loizaiyore Ihudi okkolore dohon gorade niyom mozin he kušbo mosolla kafon horot diyore berai diye.
Isare zeṛe kurušot diya oiye, heṛe ek bagan aššil, ar he baganot ugguwa noya hobor aššil, zibat honokiyore ehono raka no o.
He din aššilde Ihudi okkolor entezamor din, hitara Isare he hoborot raikke, kiyollahoile he hoborguwa ḍake aššil.
